entries.subject: DAMIT 169: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-169.txt. Model 169, version 2009-05-29, pole (125°, -33°), period 11.03318 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: A. Marciniak et al. (2009), Photometry and models of selected main belt asteroids VI. 160 Una, 747 Winchester, and 849 Ara
entries.finding: [A. Marciniak et al. (2009), Photometry and models of selected main belt asteroids VI. 160 Una, 747 Winchester, and 849 Ara](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A%26A...498..313M) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 77.72 ± 1.23 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 160 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The selected record has no calibrated size and supplies no registered imagery; retain explicitly approximate AKARI scaling.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 170, pole ['308', '-41'], [Model 170](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/170) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 170: pole (308°, -41°), 11.03316 h, version 2009-05-29. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
